claims.who: Bausch & Lomb with John A. Macready
claims.quote: In 1929, US Army Air Corps Colonel John A. Macready worked with Bausch & Lomb, a Rochester, New York-based medical equipment manufacturer, to create aviation sunglasses that would reduce the distraction for pilots caused by the intense blue and white hues of the sky.
claims.note: Macready and Bausch & Lomb created aviation sunglasses
